main_body: Beehive thatched hut: a large domed straw roof (rows 0-56) over a clay-brick wall with an arched doorway (rows 57-77)
top_band: Roof slope: golden thatch (L≈186/154/124) from row 2 down to row ~55 in the x=40 column, in horizontal courses. It ends at a dark eave line (L≈44-69) before the wall. The door column shows the arch and the dark opening.
evidence: The thatched dome is a large sloped roof surface seen from above, with courses stepping lighter at the top and darker toward the rim. Like the reference gabled roofs, it counts as the roof top. The roof overhangs and casts a dark shadow band (rows ~56-60) onto the wall below. The wall is a distinct vertical front face with its own brick texture and a plinth. The doorway is inset, with a frame and a dark interior. No receding side face is drawn.

style.evidence: The thatch has 5-6 lightness steps with per-course tick marks and light and dark rows. The outline is a tinted dark brown (only 5% neutral edge pixels), matching the adjacent material. The wall has brick dashes and a gradient but is a bit plainer. Median 8 colours per tile sits slightly below the references (11 and 18), and 31 distinct colours is low, but flat-fill coverage is only 12% (mostly the dark doorway), so the piece holds up next to the references without looking sticker-like.
